drivers.title: Tech rebounds, Apple drags the Dow
drivers.text: The S&P 500 rose 0.4% to 7,569 and the Nasdaq 0.8% as Nvidia, AMD and Broadcom bounced, even though most S&P stocks fell. Apple dropped about 2% on a weak margin outlook, pulling the Dow down 0.4%.

src.t: CNBC: S&P 500 snaps 3-day skid on Election Day as chip stocks rebound

drivers.title: Oil slips on US-Iran talks hopes
drivers.text: Brent settled at $103.60, down 1.1%, and WTI at $96.09, down 0.4%, on speculation of progress in US-Iran negotiations. That follows Monday's drop of about 7%.

src.t: CNBC: S&P 500 snaps 3-day skid on Election Day as chip stocks rebound

drivers.title: Midterms: Democrats win, futures jump
drivers.text: Overnight, Dow futures jumped about 800 points after a decisive Democratic win in the midterms. The 10-year closed Tuesday at 4.95%, up 4 bp, and futures put a December Fed hike at about 79%.

sowhat.text: Credit is open, with HSBC selling $4.25B of bonds, and large deals keep coming, with Marvell and Lumentum at ~$115B and $3.1B going into LNG Canada. The 10-year at 4.95% and about 79% odds of a December hike keep debt costly, so cash-rich buyers and infrastructure money have the edge.

pitch: The S&P 500 rose 0.4% to about 7,569 on Election Day as chip stocks bounced, though the Dow slipped 0.4% on Apple. Oil eased again, with WTI at 96 dollars, on hopes for US-Iran talks. The 10-year rose 4 basis points to 4.95%, and the market puts about a 79% chance on a Fed hike on December 9. Overnight, futures jumped after Democrats won big in the midterms. On deals, Marvell agreed to buy Lumentum for about 115 billion dollars in stock, and Blackstone and Canadian pensions are paying 3.1 billion dollars into LNG Canada.

quiz.q: Where did the 10-year Treasury yield close on Tuesday 3 Nov?
Why did the Dow fall 0.4% while the Nasdaq rose 0.8% on Tuesday?
quiz.a: Apple fell about 2% on a weak margin outlook and weighed on the Dow, while Nvidia, AMD and Broadcom rebounded and lifted the Nasdaq.

quiz.q: Who advised Lumentum on its sale to Marvell?
quiz.a: Citi and Evercore advised Lumentum. Qatalyst, J.P. Morgan and Goldman Sachs advised Marvell.

chat.a: On Election Day the S&P 500 rose 0.4% to 7,569 as chip stocks rebounded, while the Dow fell 0.4% on Apple. Oil slipped again, with WTI at $96.09. The 10-year rose to 4.95%, and Dow futures jumped overnight after Democrats won the midterms.
chat.tip: Lead with the tech and Dow split.

chat.q: What's your read on oil this week?
chat.a: WTI settled at $96.09 and Brent at $103.60, both lower on hopes for US-Iran talks, after a large drop Monday. Headlines can reverse that quickly. If oil holds near these levels, energy cash flows stay healthy, which supports upstream and midstream deal appetite.
chat.tip: Say both directions: talks down, supply scares up.

chat.a: Marvell is buying Lumentum for about $115B in stock at roughly a 24% premium, with Qatalyst, J.P. Morgan and Goldman on Marvell and Citi and Evercore on Lumentum. Blackstone and Canadian pensions are also paying $3.1B for 49.9% of Mitsubishi's holding company that owns a stake in LNG Canada.
chat.tip: Name the advisers; bankers will ask.

chat.q: What are you watching this week?
chat.a: The October jobs report on Friday 6 Nov, about +55K expected with unemployment at 4.2%, because it feeds the odds of a Fed hike on 9 Dec, near 79% now. Also ConocoPhillips and Parker-Hannifin earnings Thursday as reads on energy and industrial demand.
chat.tip: Tie each event to the Fed or the energy theme.

chat.q: If the 10-year rose 50 bp, what happens to a DCF?
chat.a: The 10-year is 4.95% now. A 50 bp rise lifts the risk-free rate and so the WACC, which lowers the present value of cash flows. Companies with most of their value in the terminal value fall the most.
chat.tip: Say the direction, then who is hit hardest.

chat.q: How does a stock-funded deal like Marvell and Lumentum get done in a volatile tech tape?
chat.a: Marvell is paying in stock, 4.5 Marvell shares per Lumentum share, at a roughly 24% premium to unaffected prices on 28 Oct. The Nasdaq-100 is about 10% below its high, so a fixed exchange ratio protects both sides from relative moves but not from the sector falling. Buyers with weaker currency lean toward cash or hard-asset deals.

chat.q: How do the Fed and the 10-year affect M&A financing right now?
chat.a: The Fed target is 3.75–4.00% after a 25 bp hike in September, and futures price about a 79% chance of another on 9 Dec. The 10-year is 4.95%, so debt is costly. High yield spreads were 343 bp on 2 Nov, and HSBC sold $4.25B of bonds Tuesday, so markets are open.
chat.tip: Separate the base rate from the credit spread.
